line: Nio, it's Sunday night. Why are you dressed like that?
note: Quick and flat, like she already regrets asking.

line: There's an after hours tonight. It starts at eleven.
note: Quick and hyped, a little out of breath from dancing.

line: You have never once been awake at eleven.
note: Quick and dry, stating a fact.

line: It's free, Maya. Look at that. Free.
note: Quick, like that settles it, holding up his phone.

line: You fell asleep at your own birthday party.
note: Quick and dry, not letting it go.

line: That was a nap, and tonight I am locked in.
note: Quick, defensive, very sure of himself.

line: I'm just going to sit down for one second.
note: Easy and casual, already a little sleepy.

line: Nine thirty-one. That's a new record for him.
note: Quiet and dry, almost impressed, so she doesn't wake him.
